The model found that the difference in cost of a large taxis compared to a small taxis significantly vary in these three scenarios.

scenario one compared an all gas van with an all gas sedan and resulted in a large vehicle fare of $16.82.

scenario three compared a hybrid van with a hybrid sedan and resulted in a large vehicle fare of $11.20.

The purpose of this report is to seek council's approval to allow early procurement and contract award for portion of the 2027 and 2028 roadway and sidewalk capital preservation program.
Roads and sidewalk preservation program is a reoccurring annual capital program that delivers roadway rehabilitation sidewalk rehabilitation and roadway network assessments.
This program is established program with consistent annual funding and ongoing project delivery requirements.
Under the current procurement process.

We can not proceed until after budget approval. Combined with the standard procurement timelines and staged tenders. It often results in construction awards and late spring or early summer. Reducing the effective construction window and limiting flexibility in the program delivery.
Administration has evaluated four options for early procurement of the program. 180% 60% and 40% and then one with the current process with no early procurement.
Administration with the four options is recommending option two, which would allow for early procurement and contract award of up to 60% of the anticipated program funding for two year pilot.
This option provides a balance between improving project delivery and maintaining financial flexibility during the budget deliberations.

Or the procurement would allow for meaningful portion of the program to be brought forward to market sooner, supporting improved contract availability, competitive bidding, and provide additional time for contracts to secure contractors to secure labor, materials and equipment in advance of the construction season.

At the same time, approximately 40% of the program funding would remain available for future budget deliberations, preserving council's ability to respond to changing priorities, growth pressures and inflationary impacts.

Administrative stations recommending this as a two-year pilot to allow sufficient time to implement the process, evaluate results, and obtain industry feedback before we consider a long-term approach.
